description: This file defines the IncomingDataBuffer class, which implements a thread-safe byte buffer used for handling incoming data streams from a controller, including methods for adding data, waiting for specific byte counts, and extracting data.

classes.name: IncomingDataBuffer
classes.description: A thread-safe buffer class for managing incoming control data bytes, providing synchronized methods for adding, waiting for, and retrieving data.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds new byte data to the buffer and logs this event.

methods.name: waitForBytes
methods.description: Blocks until the specified number of bytes are available or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: dropPending
methods.description: Clears any pending data in the buffer and logs the dropped data.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Retrieves a short value from the buffer in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from the buffer in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Copies data from the buffer into the provided byte array.
